author: Mo Willems

notes: This is a Mo Willems Elephant and Piggie book. The central concept is Piggie sharing her favourite food (slop) with Gerald, who is reluctant but tries it. Key vocabulary revolves around food, tasting, reactions (yucky vs delicious), and friendship. Both Gerald (elephant) and Piggie are named Mo Willems characters and will need sourced clip art — generic Boardmaker elephant/pig icons will not match student recognition from the book cover. Consider adding Piggie as a secondary fringe image if space allows on an expanded board.
